newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissho Iwai to set up finance firm in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Nissho Iwai to set up finance firm in Singapore.

text.p: Japanese trading house Nissho Iwai Corp said on Monday that it plans to set up a wholly owned finance subsidiary in Singapore later this month.

The new firm, Nissho Iwai Capital Asia Pte Ltd, will be capitalised at 15 million Singapore dollars and trade bonds and derivative products, deal listed stocks and invest in venture businesses, Nissho Iwai said in a statement.

The firm will start operating in November with investment assets worth $500 million, the statement said. Nissho Iwai set up a similar firm in Britain called Nissho Iwai International Finance Plc in 1985.
